prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a black wall covered in bold, white graffiti. The graffiti features stylized, hand-painted text reading “SAID BAISSE LA POLICE,” with dynamic, sweeping lines and accent marks that give the writing an energetic, rebellious feel. Above the text, there is a large peace symbol, and below, a copyright symbol and a thick arrow pointing to the right, all rendered in the same expressive, brush-like strokes. The composition is tight, focusing solely on the graffiti, with no visible background elements or distractions. The color palette is stark and monochromatic, dominated by the contrast between the deep black of the wall and the bright, opaque white of the paint. The lighting is even and diffuse, with no harsh shadows or highlights, emphasizing the flatness of the surface and the clarity of the graffiti. The overall style is raw and urban, evoking a sense of defiance and street culture, as if captured by a documentary photographer intent on preserving the immediacy and attitude of the scene.
